pages.text: The Arcane Vacuum Hopper collects dropped items and experience orbs through walls. Its range can be set to 4, 8, or 12 blocks, or the entire current chunk. Larger ranges are checked less often.

Stored experience can become Experience Gems: normal gems cost 3 XP and Greater Experience Gems cost 12 XP. Use an empty hand to open the menu; sneak-use with an empty hand to deposit all player experience.

Created gems enter the shared item buffer and use the same output mode and Dominion Wand target as other items. If the buffer is full, experience remains stored and conversion pauses. An unbound output may use a container below.
Nine filter templates support disabled, whitelist, and blacklist modes. Matching can use only the item type or also compare enchantments, durability, and other stored details.
Void Matches is off by default. When enabled, matching items are permanently destroyed. A redstone signal pauses collection, conversion, output, and voiding.
